This looks great — you've captured everything I was worried about.

The saving flow is right: I paste a link, it fills in the title, description, and site icon for me, I can adjust them if I want, and if a page won't give up its details I can still save without getting stuck. The searching now does what I pictured — exact phrases in quotes, searching by tag, and combining something like "Rome" with either the article or book tag. And the read-later list with marking things read or unread is exactly the deliberate reading queue I had in mind. Good that the duplicate handling stayed the same.

I'm happy with the specification as written. You can go ahead and move on to planning.
